name: SVO Mask Mapping
definition: A bit-mapping scheme for 8 child voxels in an SVO node, stored in a single uint32_t mask field. The first 4 bits are negative Y children, the next 4 are positive Y children.
summary: SVO Mask Mapping encodes child voxel existence in a 32-bit node mask, enabling compact, pointer-free tree traversal via bitwise checks rather than serialization blocks.
